script.title: PARKING TICKET APPEAL
script.scene_zh: 市政大樓 · 申訴停車罰單
script.story_hook: A parking ticket starts a calm appeal at the counter.
script.intro_zh: 一張停車罰單，在櫃檯前展開一場冷靜的申訴。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back! Today, you'll appeal a parking ticket.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來！今天你要申訴一張停車罰單。
script.outro: You filed it, you waited, you won. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 交件、等待、然後贏得好結果。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat every sentence out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們把每句話大聲跟讀一次。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length dark brown hair, a mustard yellow rain jacket over a gray sweater, small hoop earrings, and a slim build, holding a folded paper ticket
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man in his fifties with short gray hair and a neat mustache, a navy office vest over a light blue shirt, thin glasses, a lanyard badge, and a stocky build
script.char_b_role: city clerk at the appeals counter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I think I need some help.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ θɪŋk aɪ niːd səm hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想我需要一些幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. What kind of ticket is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wət kaɪnd əv ˈtɪkɪt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，是什麼樣的罰單呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A parking ticket, sixty-five dollars.
dialogue.zh: 停車罰單，六十五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oof, that's a big one.
dialogue.zh: 哎喲，這金額可真不小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the meter was broken that day.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ðə ˈmitəɹ wəz ˈbɹoʊkən ðæt deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 但那天計時器是壞的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hm, do you have any proof?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，手邊有什麼證據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I took a photo of the meter.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʊk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə ˈmitəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我拍了計時器的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, show me on your phone.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，用手機給我看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here. See? The screen stayed dark.
dialogue.zh: 給，看到了嗎？螢幕一直是黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, that screen looks dead.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那螢幕確實完全沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So can I fight the ticket?
dialogue.zh: 所以我可以申訴這張罰單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we call it an appeal.
dialogue.zh: 當然，我們把這叫做申訴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. How does the appeal work?
dialogue.zh: 好的，申訴要怎麼進行？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You fill a short form first.
dialogue.zh: 你首先要填一張簡短的表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine. Where do I get one?
dialogue.zh: 行，我去哪裡拿表格？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, just one page.
dialogue.zh: 給你，整整只有這一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. What do I write here?
dialogue.zh: 很好，這一欄要寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your name, plate number, ticket date.
dialogue.zh: 你的名字、車牌號碼和罰單日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Anything else on it?
dialogue.zh: 記下了，表格上還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, write why you think the ticket is wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs raɪt waɪ ju θɪŋk ðə ˈtɪkɪt ɪz ɹɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有的，寫下你認為罰單不對的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I mention the broken meter?
dialogue.zh: 我該提到計時器壞掉這件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Definitely. That's your best point.
dialogue.zh: 一定要寫，那是你最有力的論點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the sign was hard to see there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd ðə saɪn wəz hɑɹd tə si ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 還有那塊標誌牌在那裡很難看見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, mention that too, please.
dialogue.zh: 喔，這一點也請一併寫進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, there's a problem with my plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðɛɹz ə ˈpɑbləm wɪð maɪ pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的車牌資料有個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What's up with it?
dialogue.zh: 是發生什麼事了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The form asks for a state.
dialogue.zh: 表格要求填寫汽車登記的州。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, your car is from out of state.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ jɔɹ kɑɹ ɪz fɹʌm aʊt əv steɪt/
dialogue.zh: 啊，你的車是外州牌照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. I forgot all about that.
dialogue.zh: 對呀，我把這件事忘得乾乾淨淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, just write 'visitor' there.
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，在那格寫訪客就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Do I mail this in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi ɪˈnʌf du aɪ meɪl ɪs ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不難。這張要用郵寄回去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, hand it to me today.
dialogue.zh: 不用，今天直接交給我就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Do I need a hearing?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我需要參加聽證會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a short one, about ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə ʃɔɹt wʌn əˈbaʊt tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 要的，很短，大約十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes? When are they held?
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘？聽證會都安排在何時？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesdays only. The next one is the 14th.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪz ˈoʊnli ðə nɛkst wʌn ɪz ðə ˈfɔɹθˈtiːnθ/
dialogue.zh: 只在星期二辦，下一場是十四號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The 14th… I work that morning.
dialogue.zh: 十四號…那天上午我要上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, there's a late slot at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɛɹz ə leɪt slɑt æt fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，四點還有一個晚間時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four o'clock works better for me.
dialogue.zh: 四點對我來說更為合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll book you for four.
dialogue.zh: 好，我幫你預約四點場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Should I bring anything else?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我還需要攜帶別的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your ID and the ticket itself.
dialogue.zh: 你的身分證，還有罰單正本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh oh… I can't find the ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ ˈoʊ aɪ kænt faɪnd ðə ˈtɪkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 糟糕…我找不到那張罰單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your jacket pocket, maybe?
dialogue.zh: 要不要摸一下你外套的口袋？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're right! It was in here.
dialogue.zh: 你說對了！它就藏在這裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. I'll note the ticket number.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我來登記罰單號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will this stop the late fee?
dialogue.zh: 這樣滯納金就會暫停累積嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your clock pauses after this.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，交件之後時鐘就暫停走動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a relief, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我整顆心都放下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your stamped copy. Keep it.
dialogue.zh: 這是蓋章的複本，請好好收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my photo? Do I send it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ ˈfoʊtoʊ du aɪ sɛnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我的照片呢？要寄給你們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just show it on your phone there.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ʃoʊ ɪt ɑn jɔɹ foʊn ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 到時候用手機直接給他們看就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, so I'm all set now?
dialogue.zh: 好極了，這樣我全都準備妥當了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set. Good luck with the hearing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt ɡʊd lʊk wɪð ði ˈhɪɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 都對了，聽證會一切順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much for this.
dialogue.zh: 真的非常感謝你這番協助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Have a safe drive home.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɑbləm hæv ə seɪf dɹaɪv hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，回家路上開車小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Thanks again, bye!
dialogue.zh: 我會的，再次道謝，再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Hope they cancel it fast.
dialogue.zh: 再見！希望他們盡快撤銷這張罰單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Me too. Have a good afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 我也這樣希望，祝你下午愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too. Take care now.
dialogue.zh: 你也是，好好照顧自己。

在市政大樓的申訴櫃檯前，一位司機拿著65美元的罰單，說明計時器故障、標誌難找，櫃員帶著她填表、選聽證時段、留下蓋章複本。整段對話只有一個連續場景，越聊越深，句句都能直接搬進你的生活裡使用。

script.youtube_description_en:
What do you do with an unfair parking ticket? Follow this 60-line American English listening practice and appeal it step by step 🅿️

At the city appeals counter, a driver explains a broken meter and a hidden sign. The clerk walks her through the form, a hearing time slot, and a stamped copy, all in one continuous scene that keeps going deeper. Every line teaches something you can reuse in real life.

You will hear:
- Explaining the problem: But the meter was broken that day.
- Asking for steps: How does the appeal work?
- Booking a slot: Four o'clock works better for me.
- Friendly wrap-up: Good luck with the hearing.

The second half is line-by-line listening plus shadowing practice 🎧, with sentences under 10 words and connected-speech IPA. Perfect for A2 learners.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
收到停車罰單，只能乖乖繳錢嗎？
如果計時器根本就是壞的呢？能不能當面說清楚？

這一集帶大家走進市政大樓的申訴櫃檯，看一位司機如何填表、挑時間、拿到蓋章複本，把罰單安安靜靜地處理掉。

你會聽到：
🅿️ 說明狀況：But the meter was broken that day. 一句就講懂來龍去脈。
📝 請求指引：How does the appeal work? 請對方一步步帶著走。
🕓 預約時段：Four o'clock works better for me. 禮貌地挑時間。
🎧 收尾道謝：Good luck with the hearing. 聽證會前後都適用的問候。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，每句不超過十個單字，標上連讀IPA，讓你反覆磨耳朵，不知不覺就能開口。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，把整場申訴流程聽成自己的直覺。

願你下次拿到罰單時，也能這樣從容地說一句：I think I need some help.
